scope: Federal workforce-system knowledge, local workforce navigation, occupational tools research, and archival agricultural recruitment policy

records.name: DOL Agricultural Recruitment System — GAL 07-92
records.description: Historical 1992 U.S. Department of Labor guidance on implementing an improved Agricultural Recruitment System and providing labor-market and employment services to agricultural employers.
records.availability_notes: Issued in 1992. Preserve for historical and policy research only; do not present as current legal guidance, a current recruitment procedure, or an enrollment resource without checking current federal and state rules. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: WorkforceGPS
records.description: U.S. Department of Labor-sponsored knowledge platform offering workforce-system resources, technical-assistance materials, communities, webinars, research, promising practices, and policy implementation tools.
records.availability_notes: Primarily designed for workforce professionals, grantees, program operators, and partners rather than direct job-seeker enrollment. Some participation features may require an account. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: CareerOneStop American Job Center Finder
records.description: National locator for nearby American Job Centers, including comprehensive and affiliate centers offering free job-search help, career counseling, skills assessments, workshops, training referrals, resource rooms, veteran services, youth services, and supportive-service connections.
records.availability_notes: Services vary by center. Users should confirm current hours, appointments, accessibility, veteran and youth staffing, funding, and supportive-service availability directly with the selected location. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: CareerOneStop Tools and Technology Finder
records.description: Career exploration tool showing commonly used tools, machines, devices, and technologies associated with occupations, helping users understand job requirements, compare pathways, and plan training or equipment needs.
records.availability_notes: Occupational information describes common tools and technologies and may not match every employer, worksite, specialization, or local training program. Use it for planning rather than as a guarantee of job requirements. Verified August 6, 2026.
